columns.solution: name of the solution, product, or technique
columns.approach: how it works in one line
columns.maturity: experimental | emerging | established | legacy, as the page implies
columns.evidence: the claim or number backing it, verbatim and short

solutions.hint: One row per distinct solution the page describes or recommends.

landscape.answers: Who and what is in space X?

columns.entity: company, product, project, standard, or org
columns.category: what kind of thing it is
columns.positioning: how it is positioned or differentiated
columns.key_facts: funding, size, launch date, adoption, as stated

landscape.hint: One row per named entity that plays a role in the space.

columns.value: the stated value/judgement for this option on this criterion

comparison.hint: One row per option x criterion cell the page actually states. Never infer missing cells.

columns.impact: stated impact, with numbers if any

situation.hint: One row per event or development.

columns.evidence: how the page shows it (log, repro, benchmark)

how_to.answers: What are the steps to do X?
how_to.hint: One row per step, in the page's order.
